stories.title: A Genève, le festival Electron rend hommage aux femmes précurseures de l’électro

en.title: In Geneva, the Electron festival pays tribute to pioneering women in electronic music
en.summary: Many female composers played crucial roles in inventing synthesized music but remain largely unrecognized. The show "Pionnières!" presented in Geneva highlights their contributions, contrasting them with celebrated male pioneers who have long been part of official music history.

stories.title: Les étudiants français rejoignent les lycéens dans leur mouvement de protestation

en.title: French university students join high school students in their protest movement
en.summary: University students have joined high schools across France in organizing blockades to demand teacher replacements and increased funding. This represents a potential second wave of youth-driven social mobilization in the country.

stories.title: 200 Milliarden Dollar: Donald Trump kündigt hohe Investitionen Südkoreas an

en.title: 200 billion dollars: Donald Trump announces high South Korean investments
en.summary: The US President announced planned South Korean investments including a gas power plant, eight nuclear reactors, and a gas pipeline. South Korea downplayed the announcement, though the investments appear connected to securing favorable tariffs and maintaining alliance commitments.

stories.title: Die Stadt Zürich will auf der stark befahrenen Rosengartenstrasse Tempo 30 einführen. Die Kantonspolizei verweigerte dies – zu Recht, sagt nun die Regierung

en.title: Zurich wants to introduce 30 km/h speed limit on busy Rosengarten Street. Cantonal police refused - the government now agrees it was right
en.summary: Zurich's government rejected the city's plan to implement a 30 km/h speed limit and add pedestrian crossings on the heavily trafficked Rosengartenstrasse. The city expressed disappointment with the cantonal decision.

stories.title: Rumänien steckt in der politischen Sackgasse fest

en.title: Romania stuck in political deadlock
en.summary: Romania has failed to form a government for the third time since June in Bucharest. The political standstill is proving costly for the country.

stories.title: "Backpack" gagne le titre de l'ours brun le plus gras d'Alaska au terme d'une compétition serrée

en.title: "Backpack" wins title of fattest brown bear in Alaska in close competition
en.summary: After an extremely tight week-long competition, Fat Bear Week declared a 20-year-old male bear named Backpack as Alaska's fattest brown bear for 2026 based on online voting.

stories.title: Sie atmete nach zwei Dosen weiter: Verurteilte Mörderin überlebt Hinrichtungsversuch in den USA

en.title: Convicted murderer survives execution attempt in the USA after two doses
en.summary: Christa Pike's scheduled execution in the United States on Wednesday failed when she continued breathing after administration of lethal injection. This marks Tennessee's second failed execution attempt in recent months.

stories.title: L'exécution d'une femme échoue dans le Tennessee, aux Etats-Unis

en.title: Execution of a woman fails in Tennessee, United States
en.summary: An execution scheduled for Wednesday evening in Tennessee did not proceed as planned. The condemned woman was transported to a nearby hospital for medical treatment.

stories.title: Hinrichtung in den USA – Zum Tode Verurteilte lebt nach zwei Giftspritzen noch

en.title: Execution in the USA – Death Row Inmate Survives Two Lethal Injections
en.summary: The first execution of a woman in Tennessee in over 200 years encountered complications when the inmate survived the lethal injection procedure.

stories.title: Une exécution par injection létale échoue dans le Tennessee, la condamnée hospitalisée après avoir continué à respirer

en.title: Lethal Injection Execution Fails in Tennessee, Condemned Woman Hospitalized After Continuing to Breathe
en.summary: A 50-year-old woman scheduled for execution in Tennessee survived the lethal injection and was hospitalized. The state governor suspended all scheduled executions and ordered an investigation into the failed procedure.

stories.title: En 2026, les glaciers du Rhône et d’Aletsch ont connu une fonte la plus importante jamais enregistrée

en.title: In 2026, the Rhône and Aletsch glaciers experienced the most significant melting ever recorded
en.summary: Swiss glaciers experienced a catastrophic year in 2026, losing 5.5% of their volume, bringing total losses to nearly 20% over five years at a rate twice faster than the previous five-year period.

stories.title: Une "année catastrophique" de plus pour les glaciers suisses en 2026, s'alarment les spécialistes

en.title: Another "catastrophic year" for Swiss glaciers in 2026, specialists warn
en.summary: A low-snow winter and successive heat waves from May to September caused severe damage to Swiss glaciers, which lost 5.5% of their volume compared to the previous year, according to the Swiss Academy of Natural Sciences.

stories.title: 200 Milliarden Dollar: Donald Trump kündigt hohe Investitionen Südkoreas an

en.title: 200 Billion Dollars: Donald Trump Announces Major South Korean Investments
en.summary: The US president announced South Korean investments including a gas power plant, eight nuclear reactors, and a gas pipeline. South Korea downplayed the announcement, but the investments appear linked to obtaining favorable tariffs and strengthening alliances.

stories.title: «Geht zum Teufel, wir wollen euch nicht!»: Warum sind die Amerikaner so wütend auf die KI-Rechenzentren? Eine Spurensuche in Texas

en.title: "Go to Hell, We Don't Want You!": Why Are Americans So Angry About AI Data Centers? An Investigation in Texas
en.summary: Opposition to AI data centers is growing across the United States, including in business-friendly Texas. Local resistance is prompting political action ahead of midterm elections.

stories.title: MELDUNGEN WIRTSCHAFT - Die Schweizer Jahresinflation erreicht ein Prozent +++ Mercedes-Benz reaktiviert Abfindungsprogramm in Deutschland

en.title: ECONOMIC REPORTS - Swiss annual inflation reaches one percent +++ Mercedes-Benz reactivates severance program in Germany
en.summary: Swiss annual inflation has reached one percent. Mercedes-Benz is reactivating a severance package program for its German workforce.

stories.title: DIE NEUESTEN ENTWICKLUNGEN - Krise bei Volkswagen: Die VW-Softwaretochter Cariad will weitere Stellen abbauen

en.title: LATEST DEVELOPMENTS - Crisis at Volkswagen: VW software subsidiary Cariad plans further job cuts
en.summary: Volkswagen faces significant restructuring, with Europe's largest automaker planning 50,000 additional job reductions by 2030. The software subsidiary Cariad is part of these cutbacks.

stories.title: Infomaniak geht als erste Schweizer IT-Firma seit Jahren an die Börse – und setzt dabei auf chinesische Technologie

en.title: Infomaniak becomes first Swiss IT company in years to go public – and relies on Chinese technology
en.summary: Geneva-based cloud provider Infomaniak is going public while positioning itself as ethical and defending Swiss digital sovereignty, despite using an open-source model from China.
